3Comparable sources

Three methods. One precise estimate.

01

Comparable sales

We analyse recent sold prices within 1km, weighted by property similarity, distance, and recency.

02

Price per m²

Using local price-per-square-metre rates from EPC and PropertyData, adjusted for property features.

03

Growth projection

Your property's last recorded sale price is forward-projected using local HPI indices.
